selection_rule: Test fixed offsets from -8.0 to +4.0 degrees in 0.5 degree steps across all three now-development datasets; require zero hard-negative movement rows, zero wrong-sign moves, at least two moving trials per heading, <=8 degree target error, then choose the passing offset with the smallest worst-case error and require <=6 degrees for margin.
